conversion_alignment: No systematic coordinate scaling or image-orientation error observed in normalized-and-reconstructed boxes.
coverage: All 14 categories represented in selected annotations; sparse, dense, small and occluded vehicles visually present.

findings.finding: Dense queue with overlapping vehicles and rider-inclusive two-wheeler boxes.
Single annotation covers distant three-wheeler; prominent foreground motorbike visibly lacks a box. Annotation completeness is imperfect.
Truck box appears excessively tall, extending over background above the partly visible vehicle.

Source verification resolves the large green passenger-vehicle box: annotation 7986 is category 4 (MUV), not Two-wheeler. The original preview reused colors, so the renderer was improved to unique colors and larger labels.
Others sample marks a construction vehicle, supporting retention as a distinct catch-all class.
Dense buses, cars, three-wheelers and bikes include occluded objects and very small distant vehicles.

policy: Retain original MV annotations for reproducible baseline; do not selectively relabel examples or silently drop classes. Explicitly report noisy/incomplete labels. Final YOLO dataset review still required.
scope: 32 early downloaded training-image previews, including 20 seed42 random available images; not a full converted-dataset certification
